# Country scope. Owns at least one location whose dominant culture differs from root's primary culture.
# Strictly guards `has_owner = yes` before checking `owner` inside `any_location_in_province` (UNOWNEDOWNER=0).
oe_van_v97_has_multicultural_province = {
    any_province = {
        any_location_in_province = {
            has_owner = yes
            owner = root
            exists = dominant_culture
            NOT = { dominant_culture = root.culture }
        }
    }
}
